_comment: DERIVED VIEW, HAND-MIRRORED -- there is no generator. Canonical source is DECLARED_TRANSITIONS in plugins/soleur/lib/workflow-fidelity.ts; this file is a byte-for-byte mirror of that const, and the ONLY thing keeping it honest is the `declared-transitions derived view parity` block in plugins/soleur/test/workflow-fidelity.test.ts. It has TWO consumers: the offline transition classifier (scripts/classify-workflow-transitions.sh, bash) and the SKILL.md byte ratchet (scripts/lint-skill-body-budget.py, python), which derives the lifecycle node set from every key and destination here -- neither can read a TypeScript const, while the const cannot be replaced by this file: the plugin ships as ./plugins/soleur and does not carry .claude/, so a runtime read returns nothing on a customer install. Kept OUT of .claude/phase-surface-map.json deliberately -- that file is deep-equal to the bundled web copy (apps/web-platform/test/phase-surface-map-parity.test.ts), so a key added there would push FSM edges through the web bundle, which has no consumer for them. To change an edge: edit DECLARED_TRANSITIONS, mirror the same change here, then run `bun test plugins/soleur/test/workflow-fidelity.test.ts` (parity fails in both directions) and `python3 scripts/lint-skill-body-budget.py --base origin/main` (a new node needs a ceiling row in plugins/soleur/test/skill-body-budget.json). See ADR-225.
